def: The data a search loop scores candidates on to choose parents; its scores are optimistic for the survivors.
Fresh data used to choose among a small shortlist of finalists.
Data touched once, after all decisions, to report an unbiased final score.
The upward bias in the score of the best-looking candidate among many noisy ones.
Loss of validity when a held-out set is reused to guide decisions that depend on earlier results from the same set.
Resampling test items together for two systems so that shared item difficulty cancels and the interval for their difference narrows.
A leaderboard mechanism that reports a new score only when a submission improves on the best by more than a step.
A small set of top candidates re-scored on fresh data before a winner is chosen.
